items: Flagstones round the dancefloor out past its speakers: rings of mossy old stone where there was bare grass
Auto-talk can be turned off: press 1 or T, or click its button on the action bar (remembered); with it off, hold Shift to talk
A volume slider in the corner (remembered); all the way down mutes
Home is decorated: a ring of lanterns, torches, balloons, fairy lights and candles just outside the dancefloor's clearing

Wild creatures notice you once you're within their attack range or 30 m, and give up when you rise to the treetops, or once you've left their area and are out of range and at least 30 m away; then they wander back home
Melee attackers wind up and lunge at where you were: step aside. Ravens keep their distance and shoot from far off
Party animals following you fight whatever attacks you or them; creatures parked at a sigil guard the ground round it
Nothing attacks babies, on either side: a leash of babies is safe in a fight. Babies never get angry when their area wakes: they stay home and you can still invite them
Berries heal: a party animal that eats one is back to full health (a hurt one goes for berries even if it's a legend), and so is a creature you've just invited, with a green sparkle
The old line of controls in the corner is gone: the action bar shows them (H hides it)
Party witches twirl each other, and play broom limbo: two hold a broom as the bar while a third shuffles under it
Party witches chatting show little emoji bubbles, taking turns
Party witches fly in from just off-screen, so you see them arrive
Lanterns, jam jars, fairy lights and mirror balls hang from the trees in party areas
Talk bubbles and markers sit over a creature's head however big it is, and the grass parts round big creatures as widely as they are
